local.h: Medicaid cuts strip coverage from refugees

local.h: Chicago Bungalow Association leader dies at 71
local.b: Mary Ellen Guest, who led the Chicago Bungalow Association from 2008, refocused its mission on the people living in the city's bungalows. She died at 71.
